triage.note: Answers a5's (#8534) request for a non-circular form of 'no state is privileged' by testing it on the measure rather than the operator. An empty site weighs 1; a content-averaged record with j occupied neighbours weighs c^j (1/6) sum_s prod_i omega(a_i,s). At j=1 the two agree at exactly one scale, c_0. At j=2 the averaged-record weight splits into three branches (p^2+q^2+4r^2, 2pq+4r^2, 2r(p+q)+2r^2) that no scale reconciles unless p=q=r; the gap is the content covariance a shared empty site cannot reproduce. Averaging over the neighbours' contents gives exactly [c(p+q+4r)/6]^j = 1 at c_0 for every j, since sum_a omega(a,s) = p+q+4r for every s. So the redundancy is exact in mean at every degree and pointwise only at degree <= 1: the principle is a one-bond statement. Additionally the orthogonal degree-2 branch equals 1 exactly on p+q = 2r, since 12r(p+q+r)-(p+q+4r)^2 = -(p+q-2r)^2 - the same scale-free condition #8534 found RP needs, holding at (3,1,2) and (7,3,5) but not (5,2,4).
